rule: 元画像に忠実。擬人化禁止。文字・記号は薄い図案、無地の石は元の石の形を保持。
basePrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE wide landscape reference sheet containing exactly THREE orthographic views of the SAME source subject, left-to-right: front, true 90-degree right side, back. Pure blank WHITE background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no captions, no labels, no checkerboard. All three same height and scale, entire subject within frame, clear separation and generous outer margins. CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: DO NOT ANTHROPOMORPHIZE. NO PEOPLE, NO FACES, NO EYES, NO MOUTHS, NO ARMS OR LEGS, NO CLOTHES, NO MASCOTS, NO INVENTED CHARACTER. Preserve the source's exact graphic/motif/material and silhouette as faithfully as possible. If source subject is a flat SYMBOL, keep it a flat symbol with only minimal thin-edge thickness so the side view is a narrow edge and rear view is the actual mirrored BACK silhouette of that same symbol, NOT a new design. Do not add embellishments, support frames, rims, mounting plates or stands. Remove the surrounding Othello carrier disk when a symbol exists; retain only the symbol. For plain material-only stones, preserve the stone itself, never invent a character inside it. This is faithful object/symbol turnaround, not a character concept redesign. Specific source preservation:
jobs: The source contains ONLY a smooth slightly domed polished silver-gray round stone with narrow beveled edge, NO icon. Preserve it as that exact smooth low domed disk-shaped object. Front is its circular domed silver-gray face with original subtle light-to-dark shading; side is a very LOW thin rounded lens-like profile, not a ball; rear is plain smooth silver-gray underside. Three objects only, no separate carrier disk behind them. No engraved sign or shield handles.

Only the lavender-gray brushstroke Japanese kanji 強 from source, with exact brush-shaped strokes and openings. Remove any carrier disk entirely. Do not put glyph on clothing or a stone. Treat the original freestanding kanji silhouette as an extremely thin flat cutout, front EXACTLY 強, middle nearly edge-on narrow lavender stroke, rear true mirror image of the front glyph (not another readable 強). No plaque, frame, outline, pedestal or attachments.

Extract ONLY the pale blue-gray Japanese glyph 残 and its tightly integrated horizontal gray-white afterimage scanline streaks from the original, removing the glossy circular carrier disk. Keep it an abstract glyph with horizontal striped distortion, not a person or a ghost. Front is the exact striped 残 motif; right side is a very thin edge of this flat layered graphic; back is mirrored glyph and matching horizontal streak pattern. Keep streaks restricted to glyph silhouette vicinity, no ambient blurred scene.

Only the simple BLACK OUTLINE HEART symbol from source. Remove the outside circle, white stone and its rim. Exact simple rounded open heart outline, pointed base, uniform black stroke. Front is source heart, side is near-edge-on narrow black outline thickness, rear is SAME symmetric heart outline. NO anatomical organ, NO filled red heart, no face, no other decorative marks. Extremely thin flat symbol, not inflated pillow.

Preserve ONLY original bright cyan-blue angular lightning motif: multiple sharp diagonal zigzag lightning shards/stripes with dark navy edges and white cutouts, original silhouette, original cyan-blue highlights. Remove circular white disk carrier. Keep flat abstract lightning emblem; do not invent a humanoid, face, staff or creature. Front exact jagged lightning shape cluster, side an almost flat narrow layered edge, back mirrored same lightning shard silhouette and colors. No outer circular frame.

Extract ONLY original red-orange-yellow flowing stylized FLAME motif. Preserve exact curling flame bands, golden yellow central spiral and red pointed tongues, elegant original graphic style. Remove disk and all outer round rim. No face or limbs, no living sprite reinterpretation. Thin flat flame-shaped graphic, front original flame, side narrow slightly layered edge, back mirrored same graphic, identical colors. No additional ambient flames.

Extract ONLY original blue/cyan WHITE-CRESTED SPIRAL WAVE motif. Keep original curling spiral, deep blue lower wave bands, cyan spray and white negative spaces exactly. Remove circular stone and rim. Pure flat wave-shaped emblem, no face, limbs, creature or fantasy redesign. Front original curl, side narrow thin layered edge, back mirrored same curl. No water scene or extra splashes beyond original motif.

Extract ONLY original elegant green LEAF motif and curled vines/veins. Preserve original pointed leaves, lime-green and dark-green bands, spiraling leaf veins and white negative spaces, no new leaves. Remove circular carrier stone and rim. Pure botanical graphic, no eyes, mouth, arms, roots as feet, character or mascot. Thin leaf-shaped emblem: front original, side narrow thin edge, back mirrored same leafy motif, consistent greens.

Extract original FOUR-ELEMENT ORNAMENT with flame red-orange in upper left, curling blue water upper right, green leaves lower left, yellow-gold lightning lower right, tied by original central dark branching ornament. Preserve exactly this combined openwork abstract motif and its original colors. Remove only enclosing stone/rim; keep internal pattern, no invented head or humanoid torso, no deity figure, no limbs. Front source pattern, side narrow flat openwork edge, rear mirrored same arrangement so color sides reverse correctly. No external ring, backing plate or additional symbols.

Source is ONLY a plain polished translucent golden-amber stone, smooth round LOW DOMED DISK with slim beveled edge and warm golden highlights. Preserve the exact stone form and material; no additions whatsoever. Front circular gold domed face, side low thin rounded lens-like profile not a sphere, back plain gold underside. No face, feet, arms, coins, crown, engraving, gems or extra base. Three faithful rotations of original gold stone only.

Source is ONLY a plain polished silver stone, smooth round LOW DOMED DISK with slim beveled edge, dark gray reflections and white highlights. Preserve exact stone form and material. Front original circular silver domed face, side low thin rounded lens profile not a sphere, back plain silver underside. NO face, limbs, engraving, rim decoration, character or separate base. Three rotations of original silver stone only.

Source is ONLY a smooth translucent iridescent rainbow stone, round LOW DOMED DISK, slim clear beveled edge. Preserve source colors: pink-magenta crown, orange-yellow on viewer left, cyan-blue right, green lower portion, tiny internal white glints. Front original circular rainbow domed face, side thin rounded low lens profile not a sphere, back consistent opposite-side opalescent coloration. No face, arms, legs, jewelry, wings, new features, separate base or external sparkles.

Extract ONLY source orange outlined warning TRIANGLE containing orange vertical EXCLAMATION MARK. Preserve exact orange line weight and rounded triangle corners. Remove ALL circular carrier disk and orange dashed surrounding ring. No bomb casing, mechanism, robot, face, arms, legs, fuse or any new object. Pure flat warning symbol: front exact orange triangle/exclamation, side very thin orange edge, back same symmetric orange triangle/exclamation silhouette. No mounting plate.

Extract ONLY exact solid orange DIAGONAL X symbol visible in reference. Despite name CROSS_BOMB, SOURCE SYMBOL IS DIAGONAL X, keep that orientation. Remove ALL carrier disk and dashed orange circular border. Flat solid orange diagonal X with original slightly shaded material, front source X, true side extremely narrow edge, back symmetric same X. No casing, bomb body, eyes, limbs or personification, no frame or stand.

Extract ONLY exact solid orange UPRIGHT PLUS + symbol visible in reference. Despite name X_BOMB, SOURCE SYMBOL IS UPRIGHT PLUS +, keep that orientation. Remove ALL carrier disk and dashed orange circular border. Flat solid orange + with original subtly shaded material, front original +, right side extremely narrow edge, back symmetric same +. No casing, bomb body, eyes, arms, legs, character, mounting plate, frame or stand.

corrections.prompt: Precise object edit of image 1 (generated turnaround); image 2 is original small source and is the authoritative design. Correct image 1 to remove ALL newly invented embellishments. In all three views REMOVE the anthropomorphic FACE at center (eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, beard) and ALL faceted diamond gemstones and their holders. Replace center with ONLY a narrow irregular branching decorative stem from source image 2, plain ivory-gold interwoven wavy lines, clearly ABSTRACT and ASYMMETRIC, not a face, no bilateral eye-like shapes. Preserve only the four original elemental shapes red flame, blue wave, green leaf and gold lightning around this simple central stem. Simplify peripheral ornament to match original small source. Keep white background, three views front thin side mirrored rear, same sizing. Absolutely no eyes, no head, no face, no gems, no living being. This is a graphic emblem composed of four decorative elements, not a mask or person.
